field.label: Enable Logwatch
field.help: Enable the Logwatch syslog ingestion, SQLite storage, and email alerting daemon.

field.label: Listen Interfaces
field.help: Interfaces whose IP addresses syslog-ng binds to for remote syslog ingestion (default: LAN).

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: UDP/TCP port for remote syslog ingestion (default: 514).

field.label: Enable UDP Listener
field.help: Accept RFC 3164 and RFC 5424 syslog messages over UDP.

field.label: Enable TCP Listener
field.help: Accept RFC 3164 and RFC 5424 syslog messages over TCP.

field.label: Auto-Add Firewall Pass Rules
field.help: Automatically register PF inbound pass rules on the selected Listen Interfaces for the syslog port.

field.label: Capture Local Logs
field.help: Ingest OPNsense system logs (s_all) and OPNware plugin logs (Caddy, Homer, Podman, Docker) into Logwatch.

field.label: Excluded Local Programs
field.help: Comma-separated program names excluded from local capture (default: filterlog).

field.label: Minimum Local Severity
field.help: Ignore local OPNsense logs less severe than this threshold (default: Informational).

field.label: Retention (Days)
field.help: Automatically purge logs older than this many days (default: 7).

field.label: Max Database Size (MB)
field.help: Safety cap on /var/db/os-logwatch/logwatch.db size; oldest rows are pruned when exceeded (default: 512 MB).

field.label: WebUI Base URL Override
field.help: Optional URL used in alert email footers. Leave blank to use this firewall's hostname.

field.label: Reuse Monit SMTP Settings
field.help: Reuse SMTP server, credentials, From, and Recipient from Services -> Monit. Fields below override when set.

field.label: SMTP Host
field.help: Custom SMTP server hostname or IP (overrides Monit when provided).

field.label: SMTP Port
field.help: SMTP server port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SMTPS).

field.label: From Address
field.help: Sender email address (overrides Monit alert From address when set).

field.label: Recipient Address
field.help: Comma-separated alert email recipients (overrides Monit alert recipient when set).
